name: lean-verify
description: Strict verification workflow for Lean 4 formalizations: statement-fidelity audit, machine checks (lake build, sorry/axiom scan), per-obligation independent audit, structured verdicts, and hash-bound run manifests.

interface.shortDescription: Strict Lean 4 formalization verification with audit reports and structured verdicts.
interface.longDescription: Runs a verifiable end-to-end check of a Lean 4 proof against its informal theorem contract: environment pinning, statement-fidelity audit, machine verification, independent per-obligation audit, structured verdict JSON, and a hash-bound run manifest.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me verify a Lean 4 formalization of a theorem.
